comparison.objective: Form a two-bend 45° offset in tubing; candidate separates dry media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-constrained plastic bending with springback compensation versus pouring and agitation-driven reorientation of free particles.
comparison.success_condition: Two bends within angular/offset tolerances, tube on template and still versus recovery fraction, washer retention, no loss/damage, and screen support dwell.
comparison.reason: Tube forming tests deformation and geometry, not selective granular flow.
